fields.name: Owner
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x3188BC0 (boost creation: eoc::ParseBoostData, then a new boost entity from FUN_1412dd6a0) adds this component to the new boost entity via bg3.exe+0x3196220 and stores *param_5 in it - an 8-byte entity handle; the boost is then created by bg3.exe+0x319FD20 on the same entity. The handle is the entity the boost should be attached to (owner). Live: 48 instances, all entity-handle shaped.
